title: I Want You to Know the Real Val Kilmer
description: After Val Kilmer's death, Choe uses an object found by his son and a hummingbird drawing to remember Kilmer's physical presence, voice after throat illness and layered screen identities, while reflecting on details that become visible only after loss.
